entities.name: Robert Joseph Baker
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert Joseph Baker is an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as bishop of the Diocese of Birmingham in Alabama from 2007 to 2019 and as bishop of the Diocese of Charleston in South Carolina from 1999 to 2007.
